model_annotations.English: The image displays two separate pie charts, labeled (a) and (b), each illustrating proportional distributions of distinct categories. Chart (a) is divided into six segments, each with a unique pattern and color: a large blue segment with diagonal stripes representing “the” at 31%, a medium blue segment with horizontal lines for “this” at 21%, a green segment with a crosshatch pattern for “for” at 17%, a light green segment with a grid pattern for “chemical” at 15%, a yellow segment with a wavy pattern for “to” at 9%, and a light blue segment with vertical lines for “in” at 7%. Chart (b) is divided into four segments: a large blue segment with diagonal stripes for “the” at 38%, a pink segment with a dotted pattern for “$” at 27%, a yellow segment with a wavy pattern for “equilibrium” at 19%, and a gray segment with a dot grid pattern for “constatant” at 15%. Both charts include legends mapping the patterns to their respective labels and display percentage values directly on each slice. Neither chart has any exploded or emphasized segments, and the slices in each chart appear to be arranged in descending order of size from left to right.
